_comment: Specialization and Unity are printed keywords -> card DB keywords field, deliberately NOT authored here (same treatment as the batch0 drafts). REACTION HALF: ATTACK_REACTION targeting the current attack, filtered by ATTACK_NAME_IN listing BOTH Dawnblade printings - the release note says any object named/monikered 'Dawnblade' is a legal target (e.g. Dawnblade, Resplendent), and ATTACK_NAME_IN normalises each name separately (_norm strips punctuation), so 'Dawnblade' alone would never match 'Dawnblade, Resplendent'. DEVIATION: the printed text pumps the WEAPON until end of turn (a second attack with it later the same turn would also get +1{p}); MODIFY_ATTACK binds to the current chain link (CombatState is recreated per link), so only this attack is pumped. NOT IMPLEMENTED - 'Damage this would deal can't be prevented': MAKE_NEXT_DAMAGE_UNPREVENTABLE compiles, but its replacement condition requires ev['source_player_id'] to equal the controller (effect_types.py, the _cond inside the MAKE_NEXT_DAMAGE_UNPREVENTABLE handler), and the engine's ONLY combat-damage replacement point (engine.py:2112) builds {'type','amount','target_player_id','damage_type'} with no source keys - so the registered replacement can never match attack damage; it fires only on damage routed through effect_keywords.deal_damage (the existing tests in tests/test_unpreventable_scope.py pass because they call deal_damage directly, not the engine's damage step). Authoring it would look implemented while doing nothing in real games. Expressing this clause needs the engine's combat damage event to carry source_player_id/damage_source_card, or a new generic type - both engine changes, so not done here. UNITY HALF: TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND fires via the 'defend' event dispatched to this defending card itself; DEFENDS_WITH_OTHER_HAND_CARD excludes this card and requires ANOTHER defender drawn from hand, so blocking with this alone does not fire. The release note's simultaneity requirement ('must become a defending card at the same time') is approximated: the condition reads combat.hand_defender_ids across all declared defenders, which covers compound defend-step declarations, but a defender added later by an effect is indistinguishable from a simultaneous one. 'Create a Courage token under ANY NUMBER of heroes' control' reads as one token per chosen hero (plural possessive), i.e. any subset of heroes - expressed as a CHOOSE over the four subsets possible in a 2-player game (self / opponent / both / no-one); an empty-effects option is proven (the_golden_son_yellow). Multi-hero UPF subsets beyond two are out of scope for this engine. courage token definition exists at json/tokens/courage.json.
